blocked.title: Storage unavailable
blocked.text: Haken needs browser storage. Private windows or browser settings can block it.

conflict.server: A change from another device was replaced by your newer one:
conflict.wholeText: Another device saved a version haken cannot read; it is shown read-only. Your unsynced version is kept here: export it to keep it.

logout.synced: All changes are on the server. Logging out removes the tasks from this browser.
logout.pending.one: {count} change is not on the server yet.
logout.pending.other: {count} changes are not on the server yet.
logout.keep: Log out, keep data on this device
logout.savedPrompt: Is the file {file} saved? Only then delete the data in this browser.
logout.local: Logging out deletes all tasks in this browser. There is no server copy. Export first if you want to keep them.

notice.restored: “{title}” was changed elsewhere, so it was not deleted.

settings.title: Settings
setup.welcome: Your to-do lists, on your own server. Works offline.
setup.usedBeforeText: The browser may have cleared its storage. Signing in restores your tasks from the server; a local account can only be restored from an .ics export.
setup.intro1.title: Works offline
setup.intro1.text: Everything you do is saved on this device first.
setup.intro2.title: Syncs when it can
setup.intro2.text: Changes reach your server as soon as you are online. Nothing is overwritten without a trace.
setup.intro3.title: Your order
setup.intro3.text: Drag tasks by their handle into the order you want.
setup.installFirst.title: Install first
setup.installFirst.text: On this device, the installed app does not see data stored in this browser tab, and Safari removes a site's data after 7 days without use.
setup.installFirst.howto: Add Haken to your Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen) or Dock, then continue there.
setup.installFirst.openApp: Open Haken from your Home Screen or Dock now.
setup.mode.title: Where should your tasks live?
setup.mode.serverText: Your Radicale account. Works offline and syncs when online.
setup.mode.localText: No server. Back up with .ics export.
setup.signin.title: Sign in
setup.signin.invalid: User name or password is wrong.
setup.signin.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
setup.localWarning: Moving local tasks to a server later needs an export and an import.
setup.local.title: Only on this device
setup.local.text: There is no server copy. Export your tasks regularly.
setup.demo: Demo – do not store real data.
setup.install.title: Install Haken
setup.install.text: Add Haken to your home screen to open it like an app.
setup.install.howto: Use your browser's menu: “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
setup.persist.title: Keep data safe
setup.persist.text: Ask the browser not to clear Haken's storage when space runs low.
setup.persist.denied: The browser did not allow it. Export your tasks regularly.
sync.local: This browser only – no server copy
sync.localWarning: There is no server copy of these tasks. Export them regularly.
task.title: Title
task.attachmentTooLarge: Files larger than 5 MB cannot be attached.
task.serverTooLarge: The server rejected this task as too large. Remove an attachment; the change stays saved here.
task.deleteConfirm: Delete this task and its checklist?
task.missing: This task does not exist (any more).
task.readonlyHint: Haken could not read this task. It is kept unchanged and is not written back. Details are in the list errorlogs.
task.repeats: This task repeats in a way Haken cannot edit yet. It is shown read-only; edit it in another app.
repeat.title: Repeat
